title: Case Studies & Results | Crenosoft
desc: How Crenosoft measures and reports results from AI projects, and how to request references from clients across Australia.
lead: Our team has delivered more than 150 software and AI projects since 2022. Here is how we measure the results of every AI project, and how to speak with clients we’ve worked with.
hero_cta: Book a Free AI AuditHow AI Employees work
body:
How we measure every project

We don’t rely on vague claims. Before we build anything, we record a baseline: how long the work takes, how often it happens and how many errors occur. After launch, every client receives a monthly report against that baseline.

  • Hours saved each month, against the agreed target
  • Volume handled: calls answered, emails sorted, documents processed or leads followed up
  • Automation rate: the share completed without human help
  • Exceptions handled by our team and escalated to you
  • Accuracy from monthly sample reviews
  • Improvements made that month

Published case studies

We publish case studies only with our clients’ written permission, and we share real numbers only when the client is comfortable with them. Detailed Australian AI case studies are being prepared and will be added here.

Ask for a reference

During your free AI audit, we can arrange a conversation with a client whose project is similar to yours, so you can hear first-hand how we work and what changed for them.

See it working now

Try the live AI agent on our homepage, chat with our AI assistant, or read how our human-backed AI Employees service works.
